# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-10-21 from the 2026-10-21 Hub dump.

- 3,171,188 models tracked, 900,316 declare a base model, 933,265 parent links, 88,549 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
